name: StockWatch Practice
description: Free, educational web app for practising stock chart reading with blind decisions: a hidden, normalized chart, a skip / long / short decision with a stop, then the outcome and a verdict on the quality of the decision (good, lucky, unlucky or bad) with a step-by-step walkthrough.
audience: Beginners and self-taught traders (16+) who want to practise before risking real money.
features: blind entry decisions with stop, target and time limit
place-the-stop, pattern recognition, support/resistance and trend-line drawing, position-size tasks
verdict on decision quality versus outcome, compared with rule-based strategies and a random baseline
daily challenge with a leaderboard and private groups
data: Synthetic (generated) price series; no real tickers, no broker connection.
disclaimer: Educational practice only. Not investment advice. No real money, no trading signals or tips.
